title.en: JANUS Meta Registry Visitor Doors Index — v1.6 Patch

base_index.rule: Apply this patch on top of v1.5; unchanged doors remain inherited from v1.5.

question.ru: Какой месяц рождения Иисуса лучше всего поддерживается пересечением небесных и текстовых реконструкций?
question.en: Which month of Jesus' birth is best supported by the overlap of celestial and textual reconstructions?

answer.ru: Апрель; ведущая единичная дата-кандидат — 17 апреля 6 года до н. э., но точная дата исторически не установлена.
answer.en: April; the leading single candidate date is 17 April 6 BCE, but the exact historical date is not established.

patches.seal: The sky does not prove the date; it narrows the window. The strongest convergence points to April.
A candidate date is not doctrine. Honest faith does not require false precision.

global_boundaries_added: No astronomical compatibility promoted as proof of theological meaning.
No candidate date promoted as revelation, doctrine, or scholarly consensus.
No illustrative score promoted as a calibrated historical probability.
No ancient astrology converted into modern divination instruction.
No celestial event claimed to have caused the birth.
No liturgical feast date invalidated by historical uncertainty.
core_seal_added: The sky does not prove the date; it narrows the window.
The strongest convergence points to April.
17 April 6 BCE is a leading candidate, not an established day.
Two independent reconstructions differ on the year but converge on the month.
The sky narrowed the window. The mystery of the day remained with God.
